recommendation: Keep the fixed commit. If PA now wants InsurancePlan.product to be optional, that should be handled by a new substantive tracker because it would reverse the explicit applied FHIR-24827 cardinality and is not established by the later narrative-only clarification issues.
issue_request: FHIR-24827 was Applied/Persuasive for PA. Its final resolution replaced the original InsurancePlan.parent proposal with a two-resource split: rename the product-level content to InsuranceProduct, move the former .plan backbone content into a new InsurancePlan resource, add a 1..1 reference from InsurancePlan to InsuranceProduct, make Coverage.insurancePlan refer to InsurancePlan, and update administrative-module descriptions and diagrams.
initial_application: December 2023 history partially applied the issue: b9ef5a8515 added InsuranceProduct source files, 2028e3df2d split InsurancePlan and added InsuranceProduct to the administration module, PR 2999 repeated the 1..1 product-reference requirement, 3a93debb82 added InsurancePlan.product and its search parameter but used min 0, and a66f52b70 updated search parameters. The split and target reference were present, but the required cardinality was not.
additional_context: FHIR-24694 is the duplicate tracker from the same PA/FM discussion. Confluence page 79502757 records the same two-resource plan/product refactor and a .product link. FHIR-33272 was applied in the same family but concerns InsuranceProduct.related, not InsurancePlan.product cardinality. Later Applied narrative issues FHIR-47649 and FHIR-47650 describe benefits as coming from the InsuranceProduct referenced in InsurancePlan.product and do not approve making that link optional. FHIR-49710 is later Resolved - change required example work, outside the default source-edit scope for this seed.
reconciliation: Changed source/insuranceplan/structuredefinition-InsurancePlan.xml so InsurancePlan.product has min 1 and max 1, preserving the existing Reference(InsuranceProduct) target. Added product references to the current InsurancePlan example XML files so examples remain valid under the corrected required cardinality. No generated SVG/diagram artifacts were edited.
